correctness.rationale: The Dirichlet Gram matrix is G_ij=[p_i delta_ij+A p_i p_j]/(A+1), giving kernel K(x,y)=(A+1)sum x_i y_i/p_i-A. Every interior row is a convex barycentric combination of vertex rows, with strict inequality for mixtures owing to opposing signs on positive-mass neighborhoods. Beta(a,A-a) truncated at a/(A+1) yields the exact vertex norm; gamma-process conditional Jensen strictly orders vertices by a for fixed A. The beta q-moment makes the 1+2A envelope sharp/unattained. Uniform integrability of nY_1 and bounded negative parts yield the two dimension limits. Independent beta vertex-order checks passed; finite tests do not establish all real parameters.
